LOFT PET HOUSE

Pet Hotel

A home-from-home stay and spaces to socialise for your little friend.

Our pet hotel was created to keep your little friend comfortable even when you can’t be with them. At our centrally located, easily accessible hotel, your pet is looked after by us 24 hours a day and checked routinely by our veterinarian, so you can enjoy peace of mind. Depending on their social nature, your little friend is offered accommodation in settings where they can have their own space as well as opportunities to socialise.

With our experienced, expert staff and all our pet hotel documents, licences and certificates, your little friends are in safe hands.

Let’s plan together.

Contact us for information about our services and availability.

A little preparation before boarding.

Tell us about your pet’s usual food, mealtimes, rest routine and relationships with other animals. Ask in advance what to bring and about admission requirements. Agree on arrival and departure times, how you will receive updates during the stay and who should be contacted when needed.
